finding: For the four direct Karelia 2021 points, current immutable dossiers contained the OSM feature IDs and geometry hashes but not raw OSM bytes. This supplement captures raw Overpass attic responses for the state requested at 2021-10-01, records SHA-256/length, and independently rebuilds the named feature polygon. All four provider-derived representative points fall inside their named OSM geometry in that requested map state.
limitations: The coordinate source measurement date and method remain unknown.
OSM geometry is not an official census boundary.
This supports contemporary 2021 point applicability, not direct measurement at census date.
For 2002 and 2010, the point remains inferred_continuity and depends on separate identity/continuity decisions.
